name: fix evidence coercion in decode_result, not just unknown-field stripping

current_round.prompt:
From: Kevin Xiong <kevin.xiong@insurity.com>
Subject: fix evidence coercion in decode_result, not just unknown-field stripping

Body:
Request: fix evidence coercion in decode_result, not just unknown-field stripping

Where: src/application/agent_io/contracts/skill_result.rs, in decode_result's normalization callback (the a4e27372 object.retain(...) block).

Current behavior: the callback strips unknown top-level keys, then decodes into SkillReport { evidence: Vec<String>, … } with #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]. If the model emits evidence as an array of objects (e.g. [{"id":"P1","note":"…"}]), retain keeps the evidence key but doesn't touch its contents, so the strict decode fails: evidence[0]: invalid type: map, expected a string. A completed agent turn is discarded.

Ask: extend the same normalization boundary to coerce evidence elements before the strict decode — e.g., for each non-string element, serde_json::to_string(elem) it (or lift object-valued entries into artifacts). Sketch, right after the existing object.retain(...):

if let Some(Value::Array(items)) = object.get_mut("evidence") {
    for item in items.iter_mut() {
        if !item.is_string() {
            *item = Value::String(serde_json::to_string(item).unwrap_or_default());
        }
    }
}

Even better: route a still-malformed completion through the existing structured-output-repair loop instead of hard-failing, so a bad envelope gets one corrective re-prompt rather than throwing away a successful turn.

Why code, not a client template: the supervised-skill template workaround (forcing evidence = strings) is per-node, must be re-applied after config regen / state-sync, doesn't exist on 4.2.0, and depends on the model obeying the instruction. A coercion in decode_result is deterministic, fleet-wide, and needs no per-node config. This is the same class of tolerance a4e27372 already established for unknown fields — just applied to evidence element types too.

Impact: without it, long successful implement/quality/governance turns are silently lost on a JSON-shape technicality (observed: goal 00000T12G5WS… lost ~1h of work — auth fix + 23 e2e runs — at the reporting step).
